cases.name: fault-several
cases.error: This PDF breaks 4 block contracts; fix them together. PDF block 1 (list) items must be an array of strings. PDF block 2 (stats) items must be an array of { value, label } objects. PDF block 3 (cover) meta must be an array of strings (one line each). PDF block 4 (table) rows must be an array of row arrays.

cases.name: fault-chart-shape
cases.error: This PDF breaks 4 block contracts; fix them together. PDF block 1 (chart) categories must be an array of labels. PDF block 1 (chart) values must be a non-empty array of numbers, zero or more. PDF block 2 (chart) has 1 categories and 2 values; give one value per category. PDF block 2 (chart) chartType is bar (bars across) or column (bars upright).

cases.name: fault-chart-forecast
